# sherpa-tabs

A tabbed content switcher.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Category | container |
| Figma | Tab Group |
| Source | [.ts](../../src/components/sherpa-tabs/sherpa-tabs.ts) · [.html](../../src/components/sherpa-tabs/sherpa-tabs.html) · [.css](../../src/components/sherpa-tabs/sherpa-tabs.css) · [.component.json](../../src/components/sherpa-tabs/sherpa-tabs.component.json) · [.example.json](../../src/components/sherpa-tabs/sherpa-tabs.example.json) |

## When to use it

To switch between panels in one place on the page: each child with a `data-tab` id is a panel, and `data-current-id` picks the one shown. To go to another Context, write a real `<a href>`.

## Example

```html
<sherpa-tabs><section data-tab="a">Panel A</section><section data-tab="b">Panel B</section></sherpa-tabs>
```

`populate()` is given, on `sherpa-tabs`:

```json
[
  {
    "id": "a",
    "label": "Alpha"
  },
  {
    "id": "b",
    "label": "Beta"
  }
]
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-current-id` | text |  | id of the currently active tab / panel |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Access | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `currentId` | `string` | read and write | currently active tab id (read/write) |

## Methods

| Method | What it does |
|---|---|
| `select(id: string)` | Activate a tab by id, silently — a host that sets it needs no echo. False when it is already active or unknown. |

## Events

Each one bubbles.

| Event | Detail |
|---|---|
| `tab-select` | `{ id: string; index: number; label: string }` |

## Slots

| Slot | Accepts | What it holds |
|---|---|---|
| `detail` | control, badge | trailing content beside the tab strip (badges, actions) |
| (default) | content | the tab panels; each child should have data-tab="&lt;id>" |

## Parts

Style these from outside with `::part()`:

`detail`, `panels`, `tab`, `tablist`

## populate()

`[{ id, label }]`

the tabs; the first is current unless data-current-id names one. Or its panels' data-tab and data-label
